title: SBB Tiki Boat
specs: Brand new six-passenger Beachcat saltwater pontoon boat with thatched roof
90 HP Suzuki motor, quiet and powerful
Fully U.S. Coast Guard certified captains with years of local experience
No one under 18 allowed on board
No one under 21 permitted to consume alcohol; ID may be requested

What to Bring: Food & Beverages Sunblock Bluetooth capable device to connect to the SBB Tiki Boat sound bar Cancellations must be made, and acknowledged by SBB Tiki, at least 48 hours in advance, for a full refund.
For any “behavioral” or alcohol related issues, a refund will not be provided.
Boat capacity limited to six passengers plus crew by U.S. Coast Guard regulations
Suitable for friends, family, couples, bachelor/bachelorette parties, and other gatherings up to six passengers
